theme.en: Chip Expansion Meets Tighter Access and Scaling Limits
theme.zh: 芯片扩产面临准入收紧与微缩瓶颈

dek.en: TSMC's proposed Texas fab and Arizona expansion put U.S. manufacturing investment in focus as chip sellers confront tighter access to China. DRAM roadmaps, atomic-layer etching and design tools show how the industry is pursuing capacity and efficiency beyond conventional scaling.
dek.zh: 台积电拟议中的得州晶圆厂与亚利桑那扩建，使美国制造投资成为焦点；与此同时，芯片卖方面临对华销售渠道收紧。DRAM路线、原子层刻蚀和设计工具则展示了产业如何在传统微缩之外寻求产能与效率提升。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia chip sellers reportedly seek new buyers as U.S. closes China export loopholes
title.zh: 美国收紧对华出口漏洞，英伟达芯片卖家据报寻找新买家

summary.en: Yahoo Finance reports that Nvidia chip sellers are seeking new buyers as the United States tightens loopholes in exports to China. The reported redirection of inventory points to a distribution risk for intermediaries when permitted routes to customers narrow; it does not by itself establish weaker global accelerator demand.
summary.zh: 据Yahoo Finance报道，美国收紧对华芯片出口中的漏洞后，英伟达芯片卖家正在寻找新买家。库存据报需要转向其他客户，反映出销售渠道收窄给中间商带来的分销风险；仅凭这一现象，尚不能判定全球加速器需求走弱。

title.en: Infineon outlines a 5.6 kW redundant server power-supply reference design
title.zh: 英飞凌介绍5.6 kW服务器冗余电源参考设计

summary.en: EE Times describes Infineon's 5.6 kW MCRPS reference design for common redundant power supplies in enterprise servers. The design addresses the power-delivery side of denser server systems, where usable compute capacity also depends on supplying the required electrical power. The supplied item gives no efficiency curve or production deployment figures.
summary.zh: EE Times介绍了英飞凌面向企业服务器通用冗余电源的5.6 kW MCRPS参考设计。该设计针对高密度服务器的供电需求，实际可用的算力规模同样取决于能否提供所需电力。候选条目未给出效率曲线或量产部署数据。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Filings outline a proposed $22.6 billion TSMC 2 nm fab in Texas
title.zh: 文件披露台积电拟在得州建设226亿美元2 nm晶圆厂

summary.en: Wccftech reports filings for a proposed $22.6 billion TSMC fab in Brazos County, Texas, with 2 nm technology, construction scheduled for 2027–2031 and 2,099 jobs. The report says TSMC is also considering alternative locations, including additional land in Arizona, and identifies tax abatement as material to the decision. The proposal would broaden its U.S. manufacturing footprint, but the filings do not establish a final Texas site commitment.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，申报文件披露台积电拟在得州Brazos县建设一座投资226亿美元的2 nm晶圆厂，建设期为2027至2031年，计划提供2099个岗位。报道同时指出，台积电仍在考虑包括亚利桑那新增土地在内的其他选址，税收减免也是决策的重要因素。该方案有望扩大其美国制造布局，但申报文件尚不代表最终确定落户得州。

title.en: Trump plans Arizona visit for TSMC factory expansion
title.zh: 特朗普计划赴亚利桑那出席台积电工厂扩建活动

summary.en: ABC News reports that Donald Trump plans to visit Arizona next week for an expansion of TSMC's chip factories. The visit puts the company's U.S. manufacturing buildout in the political spotlight alongside its consideration of a Texas fab. The supplied item does not provide new capacity figures or a production ramp schedule.
summary.zh: 据ABC News报道，特朗普计划于下周赴亚利桑那，出席台积电芯片工厂扩建相关活动。在台积电同时考虑得州建厂方案之际，此行使其美国制造布局进一步受到政治关注。候选条目未提供新增产能规模或量产爬坡时间表。

title.en: Huawei and partners promote domestic EDA for 3D and multi-node designs
title.zh: 华为及合作伙伴推广面向3D封装与多节点设计的国产EDA

summary.en: The Register reports that Huawei and other Chinese firms are promoting domestic EDA tools with an emphasis on 3D packaging and assemblies spanning multiple process nodes. These approaches could help designers combine available manufacturing capabilities at the package level. The item does not establish parity with leading EDA suites or resolve the underlying limits on advanced fabrication.
summary.zh: 据The Register报道，华为及其他中国企业正推广国产EDA工具，重点涉及3D封装和跨多个工艺节点的组合设计。这些方法有助于设计者在封装层面整合现有制造能力。该条目尚不能证明相关工具已与领先EDA套件达到同等水平，也不能据此认定先进制造能力的限制已经消除。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix reportedly targets 2031 for 3D DRAM production
title.zh: SK海力士据报计划于2031年启动3D DRAM生产

summary.en: TechPowerUp reports that SK hynix plans to begin 3D DRAM production in 2031. The date places a potential architectural transition on the longer-term memory roadmap, making it relevant to density scaling beyond current approaches. The supplied headline does not specify capacity, yield or whether the milestone means pilot or volume production.
summary.zh: 据TechPowerUp报道，SK海力士计划于2031年开始生产3D DRAM。这一时间点将潜在的架构转型纳入存储长期路线，对突破现有方式下的密度扩展限制具有参考意义。候选标题未说明产能、良率，也未区分该节点指试产还是规模量产。

title.en: SK hynix and CXMT reportedly prepare competing 4F² DRAM disclosures
title.zh: SK海力士与长鑫存储据报将在4F² DRAM上展开竞争

summary.en: BigGo Finance reports that SK hynix and CXMT are competing over 4F² DRAM ahead of ISSCC 2027. The smaller cell-area target makes the anticipated disclosures relevant to memory density and manufacturing competitiveness. Conference presentations alone would not establish production readiness or commercial yields, and the supplied item provides neither.
summary.zh: 据BigGo Finance报道，SK海力士与长鑫存储正围绕4F² DRAM展开竞争，相关进展预计将在ISSCC 2027受到关注。更小的单元面积目标，使这些预期披露与存储密度及制造竞争力密切相关。会议展示本身不能证明已具备量产条件或商业良率，候选条目也未提供这两方面的数据。

title.en: Equipment & Design Tools
title.zh: 设备与设计工具

title.en: Atomic-layer etching work reaches a 6-inch wafer
title.zh: 原子层刻蚀研究覆盖6英寸晶圆

summary.en: Tech Xplore reports work on etching a 6-inch wafer one atomic layer at a time. Applying layer-level removal control across that wafer size is relevant to process uniformity and precise device fabrication. The supplied item does not identify the material system or quantify throughput, selectivity or yield.
summary.zh: Tech Xplore报道了在6英寸晶圆上逐原子层刻蚀的研究。在这一晶圆尺寸上控制逐层材料去除，对工艺均匀性和精密器件制造具有意义。候选条目未说明材料体系，也未量化吞吐、选择比或良率。

title.en: IC Manage adds an MCP server to GDP-AI
title.zh: IC Manage为GDP-AI新增MCP服务器

summary.en: IC Manage has announced an MCP server for its GDP-AI design and IP management system, according to Embedded.com. The interface lets companies connect their chosen AI agents to structured design and IP data with near-real-time access across design and silicon lifecycles. It creates a direct integration path for engineering agents, although the supplied report gives no measured productivity gains.
summary.zh: 据Embedded.com报道，IC Manage为其GDP-AI设计与IP管理系统推出MCP服务器。该接口允许企业将自选AI智能体接入结构化设计和IP数据，在设计及芯片生命周期中获得近实时访问能力。这为工程智能体提供了直接集成路径，但候选报道未给出生产效率提升的实测数据。

title.en: Harmonic expands into hardware and software formal verification
title.zh: Harmonic拓展至硬件与软件形式验证

summary.en: EE Times reports that AI model startup Harmonic is expanding into formal verification for hardware and software. The move brings another AI developer into a field where machine-checkable correctness matters directly to engineering workflows. The supplied item does not quantify verification coverage, proof success rates or chip-design deployment.
summary.zh: 据EE Times报道，AI模型初创企业Harmonic正将业务拓展至硬件与软件形式验证。这意味着又一家AI开发商进入了以机器可检查的正确性为核心的工程领域。候选条目未量化验证覆盖率、证明成功率或芯片设计中的部署情况。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: U.S. reportedly proposes tariffs on South Korea over chip overproduction
title.zh: 美国据报以芯片产能过剩为由提议对韩国加征关税

summary.en: Chosun Ilbo reports a U.S. proposal for tariffs on South Korea over semiconductor overproduction. Such a measure could add trade uncertainty to Korean chipmakers' capacity and investment decisions. The supplied headline gives no tariff rate, product coverage or effective date, so it should be read as a reported proposal rather than an enacted measure.
summary.zh: 据《朝鲜日报》报道，美国以半导体产能过剩为由，提议对韩国加征关税。此类措施可能给韩国芯片企业的产能与投资决策增加贸易不确定性。候选标题未说明税率、产品范围或生效时间，因此应将其理解为报道中的提议，而非已实施的措施。

theme.en: Implementation Evidence Shapes Efficient Hardware Design
theme.zh: 硬件实现与验证证据推动效率设计

dek.en: Seven papers dated November 19–24 examine readout circuits, coherent DSP monitoring, specialized acceleration and design validation. The selection connects working hardware and system integration with synthesis studies, learned models and a survey of co-design methods.
dek.zh: 本期7篇论文发表于11月19至24日，涵盖读出电路、相干DSP监测、专用加速与设计验证。选文将实际硬件及系统集成，与综合评估、学习式模型和软硬件协同设计综述联系起来。

title.en: Circuits & Measurement
title.zh: 电路与测量

title.en: Calibration and integration of the GAPS silicon-tracker readout ASIC
title.zh: GAPS硅径迹探测器读出ASIC的校准与集成

summary.en: This thesis reports the integration, calibration and validation of SLIDER32 readout electronics for the GAPS silicon tracker, using a custom 180 nm CMOS ASIC with lithium-drifted silicon detectors operated at −40 °C. Laboratory tests with an Am-241 source and cosmic muons were followed by full-tracker calibration in flight configuration and acquisition of a Cd-109 x-ray spectrum. The work provides instrument-level validation evidence for a demanding detector application; the supplied abstract does not quantify readout noise or energy resolution.
summary.zh: 这篇学位论文报告了GAPS硅径迹探测器SLIDER32读出电子学的集成、校准与验证，采用定制180 nm CMOS ASIC，配合在−40 °C下工作的锂漂移硅探测器。作者先使用Am-241源和宇宙线缪子进行实验室测试，再在飞行配置下完成整套径迹探测器的校准，并获取Cd-109的X射线能谱。研究为复杂探测应用提供了仪器层面的验证证据，但所提供摘要未量化读出噪声或能量分辨率。

title.en: A 3 nm coherent DSP ASIC monitors fiber power while carrying traffic
title.zh: 3 nm相干DSP ASIC在传输业务时同步监测光纤功率分布

papers.authors: T. Sasai, Yukinobu Nakajima, Minami Takahashi, et al.

summary.en: The authors implement longitudinal power monitoring in a 3 nm 800G coherent DSP ASIC inside an OSFP module, recovering spatially resolved fiber-power profiles from received traffic. Experiments over links up to 1,005 km with 400ZR+ and 800ZR+ traffic show no measurable impact on Q factor or module power consumption, and include signals from third-party transceivers. This provides hardware evidence that distributed link monitoring can coexist with data transmission under the tested conditions.
summary.zh: 作者在OSFP模块内的3 nm、800G相干DSP ASIC上实现纵向功率监测，从接收业务信号中恢复沿光纤分布的功率曲线。在最长1005 km链路上，使用400ZR+和800ZR+业务开展的实验未测得Q因子或模块功耗受到影响，并验证了来自第三方收发器的信号。结果以实际硬件证明，在所测试条件下，分布式链路监测能够与数据传输同时运行。

title.en: AI & Domain-Specific Accelerators
title.zh: AI与领域专用加速器

title.en: Differential time representation supports modular SNN acceleration
title.zh: 差分时间表示支持模块化脉冲神经网络加速

papers.authors: D. Windhager, L. Ratschbacher, B. Moser, et al.

summary.en: This work represents spike trains with Differential Time Representation, using fewer bits than address-event encoding or uniformly sampled one-bit trains, and proves that multiple streams can be merged with low complexity. Modular streaming hardware and a Python framework generate parallel and time-multiplexed accelerators for SHD, SSC and PSMNIST. The authors report FPGA and ASIC implementations, but the supplied abstract ends before quantitative energy and area results, limiting comparisons with other SNN accelerators.
summary.zh: 研究采用差分时间表示编码脉冲序列，相比地址事件表示或等间隔采样的单比特序列使用更少位数，并证明多个序列可以低复杂度合并。模块化流式硬件与Python框架可为SHD、SSC和PSMNIST生成并行版及分时复用版加速器。作者报告了FPGA与ASIC实现，但所提供摘要在能耗和面积的量化结果之前截断，因此暂不足以与其他SNN加速器作定量比较。

title.en: VEGA extends RISC-V vectors for programmable genome alignment
title.zh: VEGA扩展RISC-V向量指令以加速可编程基因序列比对

papers.authors: Wei-Hong Xu, Shi-Jie Xu, Qun-You Liu, et al.

summary.en: VEGA combines RISC-V vector instruction extensions, a Forefront Stationary dataflow and intersequence parallelism to accelerate genome alignment while reducing off-chip accesses and improving SIMD utilization. Against Ara2-RVV, it reports peak speedups of 15.1× for Edit Distance and 9.7× for Smith–Waterman, retaining 10.2× and 6.7× gains for 10 kbp sequences. Post-synthesis results report 1.0% area overhead relative to a standard RISC-V core; these are synthesis and evaluation results rather than measured fabricated-silicon performance.
summary.zh: VEGA结合RISC-V向量指令扩展、Forefront Stationary数据流及序列间并行，在加速基因序列比对的同时减少片外访问、提高SIMD利用率。相对Ara2-RVV，Edit Distance与Smith–Waterman的峰值加速比分别为15.1倍和9.7倍，在10 kbp序列上仍分别达到10.2倍和6.7倍。综合后结果显示，相对标准RISC-V核的面积开销为1.0%；这些属于综合与评估结果，并非流片芯片的性能实测。

title.en: A rover integrates neuromorphic audio and event-based vision
title.zh: 移动机器人集成神经形态音频与事件视觉

papers.authors: Guillem Fustier-Castillo, Ruben Ribes-Serrano, Javier Naranjo-Alcazar, et al.

summary.en: This technical report integrates three real-time perception pipelines on a four-wheel rover: PANNs audio tagging on an NVIDIA Jetson, SNN audio processing on a SynSense Xylo Audio 2 chip, and SpikeYOLO detection of traffic cones from event-camera input. The Xylo audio path performs microphone-to-classification processing on-chip, while containerized services connect through ROS 2. The contribution is system integration on a robotic platform; the supplied abstract gives no quantitative end-to-end latency or energy comparison.
summary.zh: 这份技术报告在四轮移动机器人上集成了三条实时感知流程：NVIDIA Jetson上的PANNs音频标注、SynSense Xylo Audio 2芯片上的SNN音频处理，以及利用事件相机输入的SpikeYOLO交通锥检测。Xylo音频通路从麦克风信号到分类均在片上完成，各容器化服务通过ROS 2连接。研究贡献在于机器人平台上的系统集成；所提供摘要未给出端到端时延或能耗的定量对比。

title.en: Design Automation & Validation
title.zh: 设计自动化与验证

title.en: Learning passive interconnect and power-delivery macromodels directly from layouts
title.zh: 从版图直接学习无源互连与供电网络宏模型

summary.en: The authors map physical layout graphs directly to multi-order port-Hamiltonian macromodels whose parameterization guarantees continuous-frequency passivity and stability by construction. One forward pass yields models of different orders through state slicing, with training supervised by S-parameters rather than reference state-space realizations. Evaluation covers 27,000 unseen structures from a 270,000-structure advanced-packaging dataset, but the supplied abstract truncates before the numerical error results. The method targets stable signal- and power-integrity simulation without a separate passivity-repair step.
summary.zh: 作者将物理版图图结构直接映射为多阶端口哈密顿宏模型，通过参数化结构本身保证连续频域的无源性与稳定性。模型一次前向传播即可通过状态切片获得不同阶数，训练直接以S参数为监督，无需参考状态空间实现。评估使用包含27万个结构的先进封装数据集中的2.7万个未见结构，但所提供摘要在具体误差结果之前截断。该方法面向稳定的信号完整性与电源完整性仿真，无需额外的无源性修复步骤。

title.en: A survey maps validation methods for heterogeneous hardware-software co-design
title.zh: 综述梳理异构软硬件协同设计的验证方法

papers.authors: Oceane Bel, Andrés Márquez, Dhruv Gajaria, et al.
papers.venue: ACM Transactions on Modeling and Computer Simulation

summary.en: This survey reviews co-simulation and benchmarking for systems combining chiplets, 2.5D interposers, 3D stacks, RF modules and photonics. It connects SystemC and TLM models, gem5 full-system simulation and FPGA emulation with packaging validation, focusing on scalability, synchronization and multiphysics limitations. The paper offers a map of validation approaches for performance, energy, thermal behavior and reliability, rather than a new accelerator or a measured speedup.
summary.zh: 这篇综述讨论了包含Chiplet、2.5D中介层、3D堆叠、RF模块和光子器件的系统所需的协同仿真与基准测试。文章将SystemC与TLM模型、gem5全系统仿真和FPGA仿真验证，与封装验证流程联系起来，重点分析可扩展性、同步及多物理场建模的限制。其价值在于梳理性能、能耗、热行为和可靠性的验证方法，而非提出新的加速器或报告实测加速比。
